notes.title: Frustration Factory on MacOS!
notes.notes:
There is now both a full release and demo release of the Frustration Factory game.

(Because every OS deserves frustration)

notes.title: Minor update featuring in-game settings
notes.notes:
* New settings screen for volume control and whether or not to play level introductions
* Reordered week 3 levels based on feedback about difficulty
* Misc bug fixes

notes.title: Bug fix for "Shipped Out!" screen
notes.notes: Fixed a bug on the "Shipped Out!" screen where an incorrect number of stars was shown.

notes.title: Version 0.5.03: new sounds and bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New sounds!  When pieces enter the truck or fall from a container.
[*] bug fix: the 3-star time displayed improperly displayed the seconds value
[*] misc other bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.5.02
notes.notes:
Reworked the save game system so:

feature: cloud syncing across platforms should work
bug fixed: the demo version won't wipe out saved games from the full version.
